excerpt: A content-managed site built with AntFabric.
content_html:
One Intelligent Workspace

for , , and !

Launched at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026

AntFabric is out in the world.

The platform for AI-native organizations, set up inside your company by the team that built it.

Read the launch story

One Subscription for all your operational needs

The work your team spreads across Slack, Notion, Jira and email, in one app your company controls.

  • Pilots that never reach operations

    A chatbot in a tab answers questions. It does not run the renewal, file the ticket or move the meeting. Nothing in the business changes.

  • Tools nobody owns

    Five SaaS copilots, five vendors, five places your data goes. None of them knows the whole company, and none of them is yours.

  • Open source nobody installs

    Downloading a repository is not adoption. Someone still has to deploy it, connect it, secure it and make it fit the way your teams actually work.

An assistant that knows how your company works.

Not one you brief every morning. One that already has the meeting, the thread and the decision behind your question.

Talk where the work is

Channels, direct messages and your company inbox in one window. No decision split across three apps.

Meetings you can look up later

Recorded, transcribed and written up with who said what, on hardware we run. The audio never goes to a third party.

Work you can actually see

A board and a backlog next to the conversation that created the work. Nothing to set up first.

An assistant that sees all of it

It works with your chat, calendar and mail, on models we host. Not a chatbot in a separate tab.

01ConsultingMost organizations start here

We build your AI-native operations on the platform.

A forward-deployed engineering pod from GeekyAnts installs AntFabric inside your organization, connects it to your systems, and builds the agents, apps and features your operations need. You get running operations, not a licence and a manual.

Book a working session

02Platform

License the layer and build on it yourselves.

For organizations with their own engineers. AntFabric as the controllable layer, with the desktop and mobile apps, the agent runtime, and our team to consult when you want it.

Talk to us about licensing

  • MAP

    Pick the first operation

    We spend a working session on one real process, with its meetings, messages and systems, and agree what "running" means.

  • DEPLOY

    Install where you decide

    AntFabric goes onto hardware you approve, connected to the tools you already use. Your data does not leave the building.

  • BUILD

    Agents, apps and features for that operation

    Built by the team that builds the platform, so a missing feature is built into it rather than around it.

  • RUN

    Hand over, then extend

    Your people run it, with a human in the loop where one belongs. We move to the next operation, or hand you the keys.

  1. Custom agents

    Agents for the jobs your teams do every week: intake, follow-up, scheduling, reporting, approvals. Working from your company's memory, limited by your rules.

  2. Native desktop and mobile apps

    White-labelled apps for the office and the field. The platform's chat, meetings, tasks and assistant, carrying your name.

  3. Hybrid operations app

    One app for one operation: a floor, a branch, a fleet, a sales desk. Web, desktop and mobile from a single build.

  4. Custom features

    The platform does not have it yet? We build it into the platform, not around it, and it ships to you first.

  5. Integrations

    Your ERP, CRM, HR system and mail, connected so agents can read and act. The permissions people already have come along.

  6. Agent workflows with a human in the loop

    Marketing, sales and back-office workflows run by agents, with a person approving anything that cannot be undone.

Both, and consulting comes first. Most organizations start with a forward-deployed pod that installs the platform and builds their first operation on it. Organizations with their own engineers can license the platform and build on it themselves.

GeekyAnts engineers work inside your organization, on your systems and with your teams, until the operation runs. They deploy, integrate and build; they do not hand over a deck.

Onto hardware you approve. Meetings, messages and documents are captured, stored and processed where you decide. No third-party AI vendor is in the loop unless you put one there.

No. AntFabric connects to what you already use and captures work where it happens. Teams that want to consolidate can, on their own timeline.

Yes. On-premises or in a cloud account you control. The pod installs it there.

Thirty minutes with the engineers who build the platform. Bring one real operation, with its meetings, messages and systems. You leave with what would run on AntFabric, where a human stays in the loop, and what the pod would build first.

One Intelligent Workspace

for , , and !

Launched at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026

AntFabric is out in the world.

The platform for AI-native organizations, set up inside your company by the team that built it.

Read the launch story

One Subscription for all your operational needs

The work your team spreads across Slack, Notion, Jira and email, in one app your company controls.

  • Pilots that never reach operationsA chatbot in a tab answers questions. It does not run the renewal, file the ticket or move the meeting. Nothing in the business changes.
  • Tools nobody ownsFive SaaS copilots, five vendors, five places your data goes. None of them knows the whole company, and none of them is yours.
  • Open source nobody installsDownloading a repository is not adoption. Someone still has to deploy it, connect it, secure it and make it fit the way your teams actually work.

An assistant that knows how your company works.

Not one you brief every morning. One that already has the meeting, the thread and the decision behind your question.

Talk where the work is

Channels, direct messages and your company inbox in one window. No decision split across three apps.

Meetings you can look up later

Recorded, transcribed and written up with who said what, on hardware we run. The audio never goes to a third party.

Work you can actually see

A board and a backlog next to the conversation that created the work. Nothing to set up first.

An assistant that sees all of it

It works with your chat, calendar and mail, on models we host. Not a chatbot in a separate tab.

01ConsultingMost organizations start here

We build your AI-native operations on the platform.

A forward-deployed engineering pod from GeekyAnts installs AntFabric inside your organization, connects it to your systems, and builds the agents, apps and features your operations need. You get running operations, not a licence and a manual.

Book a working session

02Platform

License the layer and build on it yourselves.

For organizations with their own engineers. AntFabric as the controllable layer, with the desktop and mobile apps, the agent runtime, and our team to consult when you want it.

Talk to us about licensing
  • MAPPick the first operationWe spend a working session on one real process, with its meetings, messages and systems, and agree what "running" means.
  • DEPLOYInstall where you decideAntFabric goes onto hardware you approve, connected to the tools you already use. Your data does not leave the building.
  • BUILDAgents, apps and features for that operationBuilt by the team that builds the platform, so a missing feature is built into it rather than around it.
  • RUNHand over, then extendYour people run it, with a human in the loop where one belongs. We move to the next operation, or hand you the keys.
  1. Custom agentsAgents for the jobs your teams do every week: intake, follow-up, scheduling, reporting, approvals. Working from your company's memory, limited by your rules.
  2. Native desktop and mobile appsWhite-labelled apps for the office and the field. The platform's chat, meetings, tasks and assistant, carrying your name.
  3. Hybrid operations appOne app for one operation: a floor, a branch, a fleet, a sales desk. Web, desktop and mobile from a single build.
  4. Custom featuresThe platform does not have it yet? We build it into the platform, not around it, and it ships to you first.
  5. IntegrationsYour ERP, CRM, HR system and mail, connected so agents can read and act. The permissions people already have come along.
  6. Agent workflows with a human in the loopMarketing, sales and back-office workflows run by agents, with a person approving anything that cannot be undone.
